question: What tradeoff does Jackie Bavaro say a strategy roadmap can reveal when checking whether a company can reach its vision on time?
expected_points: A roadmap tests whether the plan and timeline are feasible; it is not a commitment.
Meeting the vision on time may require bigger bets and saying no to more optional work.

sections.heading: Tradeoff the roadmap reveals
sections.content: Working backward from the vision tests whether the strategy is feasible on time; the roadmap may show that a five- or ten-year vision would take far longer at the current pace. To close that gap, the company may need to start the major initiative sooner, take bigger swings, say no to more optional work, or possibly hire a team twice as large. These are choices the roadmap helps surface, not guaranteed requirements.
